en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs: on the left, an exterior view of a white church with a tall spire set on a low hill with trees in the foreground; on the right, the interior of the same church, showing wooden pews, a pulpit, and an altar in a Gothic-style chancel. Text at the bottom identifies the church and conveys a Christmas and New Year greeting dated 1903–1904, signed by Elise and John Frogner.
